newsitem.title: USA: Richfood to post Q4 charge from redemption.
newsitem.headline: Richfood to post Q4 charge from redemption.

text.p: Richfood Holdings Inc said Friday it expects to post an after-tax charge in the fourth quarter of about $1.8 million related to the early redemption of notes issued by its subsidiary, Super Rite Foods Inc.
The expected charge is from the redemption premium for the notes and the write-off of remaining deferred financing costs related to their issuance, the company said.
Richfood said it called for early redemption all of the $47.5 million outstanding principal amount of the 10-5/8 percent senior subordinated notes, which were due April 1, 2002.
The notes are to be redeemed effective April 1 at a redemption price of 105.31 percent of their principal amount plus accrued interest.
The company said it expects it will use primarily cash on hand, along with borrowings under existing credit facilities, to pay the redemption price for the notes.

"Our early retirement of the notes offers us an opportunity to realize significant interest expense savings due to the lower rates available to Richfood," President and Chief Executive John Stokely said in a statement.

"The notes we have called for redemption were issued in 1992, prior to Richfood's acquisition of Super Rite in October 1995," he added. "With this redemption, we will have successfully completed the refinancing of substantially all of Super Rite's pre-acquisition indebtedness."
